metric_definitions.rows compiling successfully: Rows for which the compiler emitted a candidate or review record after structural checks.

metric_definitions.rows missing span ownership: Rows without deterministic owned at-rest spans.

metric_definitions.rows requiring F-B morphology producers: Rows without a direct structured morphology producer carrier.
metric_definitions.rows requiring F-C naḥw producers: Rows without a direct structured naḥw producer carrier.

metric_definitions.repeated page appearances covered: Confirmed repeated page/render appearances with an available trace; never inferred from row counts.
metric_definitions.parity failures: Rows whose candidate parity witness failed.
metric_definitions.exact reconstruction failures: Rows whose generated at-rest spans failed exact reconstruction.
